card.title: Don’t Question the Premise
card.instruction: Redirect every attempt to ask why the strange situation exists toward what must happen next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hold this bucket under the seascape. I'll get towels before the gallery floor floods.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is a painting leaking? I said we should buy a print.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can choose the replacement. Tilt the bucket toward the waves.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why are there fish? This bucket's nearly full.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fetch the aquarium from reception. I'll hold this one until you're back.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 assigns bucket and towels; A3 answers why with replacement choice and bucket angle; A5 answers fish with aquarium retrieval.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 print objection gets A3 a concession about replacement but another job; B4 fish and full bucket directly prompt A5 aquarium.

relationship.evidence: B2 voices prior preference and B4 reports worsening containment needs, making B an invested helper.

heightening.evidence: B4 adds living contents and capacity pressure; A5 selects a suitable container while volunteering to hold the current one.

specificity.evidence: A1 gallery floor and leaking seascape establish the impossible emergency; B4 fish makes the next task specific.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 aquarium from reception earns its practical logic from B4 fish rather than an unconnected surreal addition.
